第三十二章 百分之二十-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》

上一章

存书签

下一章

见状，徐成连忙制止了两人，说道：“你们别这样，救你们不过是举手之劳罢了，也幸好抓你们的那两只怪物不具备传染性，要不然就算是我也救不了你们。”

现在对于所有幸存者唯一还算是好消息的便是，那些怪物并不像丧尸那样具备感染性，让幸存者即便是受伤了，也不用担心，只要伤口不致命，及时治疗就能够获救。

很快，一楼再次恢复正常，地面上的血迹也被辅助机器人打扫干净。

爻雪走进仓库，拿了一份打包好的土豆牛肉盖浇饭，走到用餐区吃了起来。

此时辅助机器人一号正在柜台前工作，为前来的客人统计积分、办理身份卡及入住手续，随着时间一天一天的过去，来到爻雪这家游戏商店的幸存者也越来越多。

其中有实在走投无路像来这里碰碰运气的，也有在搜寻物资的过程中偶然路过，在进来之后，被这里深深吸引住就此住下的，甚至还有人在发现这里跟外面说的完全不一样之后，将自己的一家老小全部带来的。

住在这里虽然需要花积分，但胜在安全啊，而且这里还有免费的水电，只要足够胆大和努力，每天也不用愁食物。

辅助机器人二号因为此时还不需要补货，所以她正在厨房里面忙碌着，将一袋袋的预制菜，预制米饭加热，等到晚上外出的人回来之后就可以摆出来售卖了。

除此之外，爻雪还拿出了十几个苹果。

当然，相较于便宜的面包饼干，这些热气腾腾的饭菜肯定要更贵。

“总叫机器人有点怪怪的。”爻雪喃喃道，“还是取个名字吧。”

不过一时半会儿爻雪也想不到什么好名字，索性就按照金木水火土的顺序，给这两人取名爻金和爻木，如果之后还能够获得机器人的话，就也按照这个顺序取。

最后是李磊，他正在打扫卫生。

“看来招工要提上日程了。”

只有李磊一个人打扫确实不太行。

这样想着，爻雪将正在厨房里面忙碌的爻木给喊了出来。

爻木的外形是一名瘦瘦高高的青年，皮肤白皙，眉眼带笑，漂亮的不似真人，事实上他确实不是人。

Seeing this, Xu Cheng quickly stopped the two of them and said, "Don't be like this. It's just a little effort to save you. Fortunately, the two monsters that caught you are not contagious, otherwise even I wouldn't be able to save you."

The only good news for all survivors now is that those monsters are not as contagious as zombies, so even if the survivors are injured, they don't have to worry. As long as the wounds are not fatal, they can be rescued with timely treatment.

Soon, the first floor returned to normal again, and the blood stains on the ground were cleaned up by the auxiliary robot.

Yaoxue walked into the warehouse, took a packaged potato and beef rice bowl, and walked to the dining area to eat.

At this time, auxiliary robot No. 1 is working in front of the counter, counting points, handling ID cards and check-in procedures for guests who come. As time goes by, more and more survivors come to Yaoxue's game store.

Some of them were really desperate and wanted to try their luck here, and some of them happened to pass by while searching for supplies. After entering, they were deeply attracted by this place and stayed there. Some even brought their whole family with them after discovering that this place was completely different from what was said outside.

Although you need to spend points to live here, it is safer because it is safe, and there is free water and electricity. As long as you are brave enough and work hard enough, you don't have to worry about food every day.

Auxiliary Robot No. 2 does not need to restock at this time, so she is busy in the kitchen, heating bags of pre-made dishes and pre-made rice, so that they can be put out for sale after people who go out in the evening come back.

In addition, Yaoxue also took out a dozen apples.

Of course, these steaming meals are definitely more expensive than cheap bread and biscuits.

"It's a bit weird to always call a robot." Yaoxue murmured, "Let's give it a name."

However, Yaoxue couldn't think of any good names for a while, so she simply named the two people Yaojin and Yaomu in the order of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth. If they can get robots in the future, they will be named in this order.

Finally, there is Li Lei, who is cleaning.

"It seems that recruitment is going to be put on the agenda."

Li Lei is really not good at cleaning alone.

Thinking like this, Yaoxue called out Yaomu who was busy in the kitchen.

Yao Mu's appearance is that of a tall and thin young man with fair skin and smiling eyebrows. He is too beautiful to look like a real person. In fact, he is indeed not a human being.
